project.name: Tiresias
project.summary: An evidence-backed 5 Whys root-cause agent for financial analysts: it explains why a company's reported figures changed between SEC filings, discovers the missing evidence, and stops at the first cause the asker can act on.

zetaris.how: The evidence layer: every claim is SQL through Zetaris plus the rows it returned; in Loop B the agent registers a newly discovered entity's SEC filings as a Lightning REST table at runtime, and the critic re-queries counterfactually.

meterless.how: H-MEM (the Meterless reference engine, vendored unmodified, behind the cognition REST service) stores lessons from past investigations, never answers, with a memory gate and an audited purge so judges can compare cold and warm runs; Nightshift is the primary model provider for all agent model calls (planned).
evidence: services/cognition: `npm run conformance` passes the official H-MEM conformance suite 13/13 against the module the service loads
services/cognition: `npm test` (remember, recall threshold, namespaces, gate reject, purge survives restart, REST)

cursor.how: Optional since the organizers' 23 Oct 2026 update. Tiresias is built mainly with Claude Code; Cursor is not a dependency of the product or the build.

nvidia.how: Nemotron models served through Nightshift lanes: a fast lane for the hypothesiser and a deep lane for the critic.
